chunks: I will cast him into the fire of Hell.

key_terms.سَأُصْلِيهِ: I will cast him (into the fire)
key_terms.سَقَرَ: Saqar (a specific level or name of Hellfire)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who are cast into Saqar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the immediate and inevitable consequence of rejecting divine guidance, with 'Saqar' often interpreted as a specific, intense layer of Hellfire reserved for those who arrogantly denied the truth. The declaration 'I will cast him' emphasizes Allah's direct agency in punishment, reflecting the concept of divine justice where the disbeliever's own actions seal their fate. This serves as a practical warning for believers to maintain steadfastness in faith and avoid the spiritual arrogance that leads to eternal separation from God.
